title: Mathematics

title: Real Numbers
text: Number systems, Euclid's algorithm, and properties of real numbers. Topics include Euclid's Division Lemma, Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic, Irrational Numbers, and Decimal Representations.

title: Prove that the square root of 2 is irrational.
text: Assume sqrt(2) = p/q in lowest terms. Then 2q^2 = p^2, so p is even. Write p = 2k => 2q^2 = 4k^2 => q^2 = 2k^2, so q is even. Contradiction. Therefore sqrt(2) is irrational.

title: Show that between any two rational numbers there exists an irrational number.
text: Given rationals a < b, choose x = a + (b - a) / sqrt(2). Then x is irrational and lies between a and b.

title: Polynomials
text: Polynomial operations, zeroes, and algebraic identities. Topics include Degree of Polynomial, Zeroes of Polynomial, Remainder Theorem, and Factor Theorem.

title: If p(x) is a polynomial with p(2)=0, show that (x-2) is a factor of p(x).
text: By the Factor Theorem, if p(2)=0 then (x-2) divides p(x).
